crossRefs.note: You have set all the boundaries of the earth. You have made summer and winter.
The heavens are yours. The earth also is yours, the world and its fullness. You have founded them.
You have created the north and the south. Tabor and Hermon rejoice in your name.
Haven’t you known? Haven’t you heard? The everlasting God, Yahweh, the Creator of the ends of the earth, doesn’t faint.…
Yahweh says: “If heaven above can be measured, and the foundations of the earth searched out beneath, then I will also…
They went up over the width of the earth, and surrounded the camp of the saints, and the beloved city. Fire came down…

translations.web: Have you comprehended the earth in its width? Declare, if you know it all.
translations.bsb: Have you surveyed the extent of the earth? Tell Me, if you know all this.
translations.kjv: Hast thou perceived the breadth of the earth? declare if thou knowest
translations.asv: Hast thou comprehended the earth in its breadth? Declare, if thou knowest it all.
